items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Herbig (hip/ribs) officially a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Nick Herbig (hip/ribs) was officially a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It initially looked like Herbig was going to participate in Thursday's practice, but he ended up being a non-participant due to the two different injuries that he's managing right now. Pittsburgh's defensive front will be a bit weaker than usual if he's sidelined for Week 11.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Roman Wilson (finger) logs full practice session Thursday
items.desc: Roman Wilson (finger) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Wilson was sidelined for over a month due to a finger issue, but he is now back at practice and was able to log a full session on Thursday. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be relevant even when he's back to full health, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Pittman has been out for an extended period of time due to a foot issue, but he was able to practice in a full capacity and seems to be very close to a return to the lineup. His return, whenever it comes, will be good news for QB Aaron Rodgers but may hurt the opportunities of DK Metcalf and rookie Germie Bernard moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Croskey-Merritt recently had his 21-day practice window opened and was able to log a full practice session on Thursday, which is a great sign for his Week 11 availability. His imminent return will complicate Washington's backfield moving forward, as Rachaad White and Austin Ekeler have both seen a lot of involvement in the young RB's absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears (knee) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Spears was back at practice on Thursday. He missed Wednesday's practice due to a knee issue, but it's not a serious issue at this point and he is expected to play through it on Sunday. He will continue to have a limited role behind Tony Pollard on the team's depth chart, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tony Pollard (rest) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Tony Pollard (rest) didn't take part in Tennessee's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Pollard was given the day off on Thursday as a veteran rest day. He should be back at practice on Friday and is expected to be a full go for Week 11.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Carnell Tate (shoulder) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Carnell Tate (shoulder) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Tate was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from a shoulder issue. It looks likely that he will play this week, but fantasy managers should pay attention to the team's official injury report on Friday, as that should give us clarity on what his status is looking like heading into the weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Luke Schoonmaker (illness) added to injury report Thursday
items.desc: Luke Schoonmaker (illness) was added to Dallas' injury report as a non-participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Schoonmaker is a new addition to Dallas' injury report, being listed with an illness of some kind that left him absent from Thursday's practice. It doesn't seem likely to leave him sidelined in Week 11, but we won't know with certainty until later in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonathan Mingo (ankle) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Jonathan Mingo (ankle) didn't practice for the Cowboys on Thursday.
items.impact: Unsurprisingly, Mingo missed another practice on Thursday due to the same ankle issue that he's been managing for a while. He isn't likely to play this week, which will open the door for Ryan Flournoy to see more opportunities against the Titans on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Booker (ankle) sidelined at practice Thursday
items.desc: Tyler Booker (ankle) was sidelined at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Booker was sidelined at practice on Thursday after suffering a high-ankle sprain in Week 10. It will likely force him to miss some time, so Dallas' offensive front will likely have to account for his absence against the Titans this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DaRon Bland (ankle) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: DaRon Bland (ankle) missed Dallas' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Bland suffered an ankle injury in Week 10 and has missed two-straight practices as a result. It looks like he's trending towards being sidelined on Sunday, which would leave Dallas' secondary short-handed in a matchup against the Titans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle/foot) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle/foot) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Porter was healthy enough to play last week, and he has been a full participant at practice so far this week, so he should once again suit up and play in Week 11. Dallas' secondary will be much stronger with him in the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) did not take part in Dallas' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Ferguson is gearing up to miss another game, as he was a non-participant for a second-straight practice on Thursday. Assuming he's sidelined this week, Brevyn Spann-Ford will again see more snaps as a result of his absence, though that may not lead to fantasy relevance for him.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) logs another full practice Thursday
items.desc: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Skattebo was again a full participant on Thursday, which means that his hamstring injury is almost a non-issue at this point. He should play and continue to be a good fantasy option in Week 11.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) limited at practice Thursday
items.desc: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) was limited at Jacksonville's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Rodriguez was limited for Thursday's practice due to a hand injury that he is currently managing. It's unclear if it will affect his availability for Week 11, but if it does, fantasy managers should expect more work for LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) as a result of his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Tuten was not able to practice on Thursday after being limited by a pair of injuries at Wednesday's practice. This may very well be nothing more than an injury management move on the part of the team, however, so fantasy managers shouldn't be concerned with his availability for Week 11, unless he still has an injury designation heading into the weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, the team left Meyers limited for another practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from an ankle issue. He should play and continue to see his usual workload in Week 11, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Antonio Johnson (ankle) limited Thursday
items.desc: Antonio Johnson (ankle) was limited at Jacksonville's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jacksonville may be without one of their key secondary players this week, as Johnson has been limited at both practices so far due to an ankle issue. Their defense will be playing at less than full capacity if he's out this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) was a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: As usual, Allen was a limited participant at practice due to a nagging hamstring issue. He should play through it this week but is not expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenneth Walker III (groin) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Kenneth Walker III remained absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Walker is continuing to trend towards missing a second straight game. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Puka Nacua receives three-game suspension from NFL
items.desc: Puka Nacua has been handed a three-game suspension for a violation of the NFL's Personal Conduct Policy, which will be served while he's on injured reserve.
items.impact: Nacua has received a three-game suspension after an NFL review determined that he violated their Personal Conduct Policy. However, he is currently on injured reserve and is several weeks away from being eligible to return, so that suspension will be served while he's on IR, meaning that this suspension won't cause him to miss any more time than he was already set to miss due to injury. Fantasy managers should continue to keep close tabs on updates about his health over the next few weeks, as he could be a very valuable asset if he's cleared to play in time for the fantasy playoffs.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyler Gordon (shoulder) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Kyler Gordon (shoulder) missed Chicago's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: A shoulder injury left Gordon sidelined for another practice on Thursday. He seems to be at real risk of being sidelined in Week 11, which would leave Chicago's secondary short-staffed against the Saints this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jeffery Simmons (knee) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Jeffery Simmons (knee) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Simmons was a limited participant for another practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from a knee issue of some kind. It still looks likely that he will play in Week 11, however, which is good news for Chicago's defense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Monangai (toe) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Kyle Monangai (toe) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, Monangai was a full participant for a second-straight practice on Thursday, which means that he will almost certainly play in Week 11. His anticipated return will mean less work for D'Andre Swift and especially Roschon Johnson moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mike Evans (Achilles) participating at practice Thursday
items.desc: Mike Evans (Achilles) is participating at San Francisco's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Evans has been sidelined for over a month while recovering from an Achilles issue, but he is back at practice on Thursday and is participating in some capacity. He still seems to be a long shot to play in Week 11, but fantasy managers should continue to keep close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Chris Bell told reporters he expects to play on Sunday against the Bills.
items.impact: Bell said he wasn't too worried about banging his knee last week. He remains off the fantasy radar.
